expect: product:FO-BQ-001 (en) is an active product priced in published
why: spec 009 AC-2's fourth rule: §13 Q1 gives every product one authored `en` slug that all four launch locales share, so an active product with a price in a published destination and no human-authored `en` row has no page in any locale — silently, because `slugFor()` answering `undefined` is a routine state in the route.
